description: Search the Oklahoma Statutes by TOPIC or keyword rather than citation, e.g. "landlord", "concealed carry permit", "DUI per se limit". Real full-text search over statutory body text (not just captions) — a query like "landlord" surfaces sections whose heading never says "landlord" (e.g. "Termination of Tenancy", 41 O.S. § 111). Returns matching citations, headings, effective dates, and relevancy. Call ok_statute with a result's citation for the full text. Keyless.

limit.description: Max results to return, default 10, max 50.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "landlord security deposit".

name: ok_search
title: Ok Search
